purpose: Keep project work moving after rejecting the over-broad whole-candidate judgment gate.
identity_rule: The same task_id is projected to the Project Cockpit and FrontierBoard; neither projection creates a human Choice.

tasks.title: 全体採否ゲートをレガシー化する
tasks.work: Reject the whole-accept-or-bounded-revision requirement itself and retain its old records as history.
tasks.unblocks: Independent project work is no longer serialized behind an invalid verdict.

tasks.title: 現行authorityを訂正receiptへ接続する
tasks.work: Record that the old current-basis adoption interpretation is superseded without rewriting its receipt.
tasks.unblocks: Current state can be read without treating the artifact as accepted or rejected.

tasks.title: Cockpitを作業一覧へ置き換える
tasks.work: Show exact artifact identity, a direct video route, and project tasks instead of a synthetic decision panel.
tasks.unblocks: The operator can see what can be done now from one temporary surface.

tasks.title: CockpitとFrontierBoardのtask identityを揃える
tasks.work: Project the ten stable task IDs to FrontierBoard as task cards and retain project-local authority here.
tasks.unblocks: Board navigation no longer depends on an invisible or withdrawn Choice.

tasks.title: 動画を開く経路を一つに固定する
tasks.work: Expose npm run cockpit, the loopback Cockpit URL, and a direct exact-media button with muted initial playback.
tasks.unblocks: Review entry is explicit and consistent for this project.

tasks.title: 部分観察の記録形式を定義する
tasks.work: Use range, observation, uncertainty, and optional requested change without forcing accept or reject.
tasks.unblocks: Useful feedback can accumulate before an artifact-level decision exists.

tasks.title: 既存8区間を任意ナビゲーションへ接続する
tasks.work: Expose existing navigation partitions only as optional viewing anchors, not approval units or questions.
tasks.unblocks: Long-form inspection can be bounded without recreating fifteen mandatory judgments.

tasks.title: DecisionCaseとworkflow readbackを非blocking化する
tasks.work: Read the legacy gate as rejected and allow evidence, rule, override, result, and artifact readback to continue independently.
tasks.unblocks: The calibration fixture remains evidence instead of becoming a parent-product blocker.

tasks.title: Episode 1 CU-02 source入力を解決する
tasks.work: Obtain explicitly supplied youtube:Ocqg-RpQURY 390-585s exact media bytes plus an acquisition receipt.
tasks.unblocks: Episode 1 can move from source preflight to integrated rough-cut preparation.
tasks.stop_condition: Do not fetch, guess, substitute, or infer rights.

tasks.title: Episode 1 preflightを再実行する
tasks.work: After exact CU-02 bytes and receipt exist, rerun the deterministic three-unit preflight; do not render before READY.
tasks.unblocks: A valid renderer entry can be prepared without turning technical readiness into production acceptance.

frontierboard_projection.note: ED-13R-07 and ED-13R-08 were completed project-locally without mutating FrontierBoard. Existing card identity remains historical read-only evidence.
